block-guide:
CORE/NAVIGATION-LINK One link inside core/navigation or core/navigation-submenu; never on its own. Read the core/navigation guide for the whole menu.
MARKUP (a comment only, no HTML) A page or post, so the link follows it when its address changes: <!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"About","type":"page","id":12,"url":"https://example.com/about/","kind":"post-type"} /--> A category: "type":"category","id":<term id>,"kind":"taxonomy" with its url. Anywhere else (external, anchor, tel:): <!-- wp:navigation-link {"label":"Shop","url":"https://example.com/","kind":"custom"} /--> "opensInNewTab":true opens a new tab; "description" and "title" are optional texts.
PITFALLS Keep id, type, url and kind together for a page link; an id without kind/type is a custom link. A link without url renders as an empty item.
